display.purpose: Full-width page titles; Redaction; clamp(2.75rem, 8.2vw, 7.375rem); leading 0.864.

body.purpose: Long-form prose; Geist; left-aligned --measure-lead 56ch; line-height ~1.65 for reading.

label.purpose: Nav, footer, eyebrows, metadata; Geist (uppercase where helpful). No monospace.

motion.name: ease-ui
motion.purpose: Short UI transitions (tooltips, 0.15s; card title hover, 0.16s).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default quiet button for errors and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgb(20 20 20 / 0.14); background: #ffffff; color: color-mix(in srgb, #141414 55%, #f3f3f3); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: #141414; border-color: rgb(20 20 20 / 0.22); background-color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c41230; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Site Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation link in Geist (chrome link pattern).
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav__link { color: #141414; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: #c41230; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #c41230; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c41230; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Prose Link
components.description: Inline link in long-form reading: underline-only, lighter-ink underline, no color change.
components.css: .ds-prose { font-family: "Geist", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.65; color: color-mix(in srgb, #141414 82%, #f3f3f3); max-width: 56ch; } .ds-prose a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(20 20 20 / 0.28); } .ds-prose a:hover { color: #141414; border-bottom-color: #141414; } .ds-prose a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c41230; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Home Hero CTA
components.description: Squared filled primary CTA on homepage hero.
components.css: .ds-hero-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.125rem 1.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: #141414; color: #f3f3f3; font-family: "Geist", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-hero-cta:hover { background: #c41230; color: #f3f3f3; } .ds-hero-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c41230; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Image Card
components.description: Square thumbnail with a subtle hairline border.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; text-decoration: none; } .ds-card__stage { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background-color: transparent; border: 1px solid rgb(20 20 20 / 0.14); overflow: hidden; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-card__stage img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c41230; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Editorial Blockquote
components.description: Serif pull quote with deep amber left rule on light surface.
components.css: .ds-blockquote { margin: 0; padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.35rem); border-left: 2px solid #e9ae0f; border-radius: 0.25rem; background-color: #dedede; color: #141414; font-family: "Redaction", Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.55rem); line-height: 1.4; }

narrative.overview: A hiring-facing portfolio where long-form craft is the interface. Serif display frames Geist body type on a Swiss light canvas; Swiss red handles interactive chrome; deep amber appears only as rare editorial punctuation. Dark bands (footer, homepage showcase) create rhythm without a theme picker.
keyCharacteristics: Two locked type roles: Redaction (display) and Geist (everything else); no monospace
Swiss light canvas (#f3f3f3) with near-black text; dark bands at #141414
Swiss red for interactive chrome; deep amber for editorial moments only
Full-width display titles; left-aligned 56ch lead column
Tonal layering over shadow stacks; work-index thumbs are square with a hairline border

rules.name: The Swiss Red Interactive Rule
rules.body: Interactive chrome — hover, focus-visible, chrome link color — uses Swiss red. Amber is not the default interactive color.

rules.name: The Amber Editorial Punctuation Rule
rules.body: Deep amber appears sparingly: text markers on the dark homepage showcase, pull-quote left rules. Never as default link hover.

rules.name: The Two-Role Lock Rule
rules.body: Redaction for display, Geist for everything else (body, UI, labels, nav, footer). No monospace.

rules.name: The Full-Width Title / Left Lead Rule
rules.body: Display titles span the layout; body, dek, bylines, and gallery intros sit in a left-aligned 56ch column.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Prefer raising a surface one token step or strengthening a border before adding box-shadow.

dos: Do use CSS custom properties from themes/theme.css for every color.
Do keep editorial body at --measure-lead (56ch), left-aligned; display titles full width.
Do apply Swiss red to interactive/hover/focus; reserve deep amber for editorial markers and pull-quote rules.
Do use Geist for body, UI, and metadata; keep prose links underline-only.
Do use semantic HTML and focus-visible outlines.
donts: Don't use SaaS landing patterns: hero metrics, identical feature card grids, gradient text, modal-first flows.
Don't ship generic AI portfolio tropes: Inter/Roboto, purple gradients, decorative glass, side-stripe accent borders.
Don't treat the site like a Dribbble shot without case-study depth.
Don't borrow corporate marketing visuals: stock heroes, buzzword headlines, logo walls.
Don't hardcode hex in component CSS or revive the blue canvas / cream text palette.
Don't use deep amber as default link hover or focus ring color.
Don't change frozen homepage headline or showcase grid layout.
Don't introduce Tailwind, Bootstrap, or other CSS frameworks; don't reintroduce a monospace face or a theme picker.
